summary: Server component (one instance, singleton-like): entities to unload/destroy because they could not be added to an inventory (esv::inventory::MemberUnloadSystem::ProcessMemberUnloadRequests, log 'Destroying entity %s because it failed to be added to an inventory'). Written by InteractionRequestSystem. Seen once, empty.

fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: MemberUnloadSystem::ProcessMemberUnloadRequests (EoCServer.dll+0xF59380) iterates the component's array at +0 with stride 8, logs each element with GetEntityDataStr and destroys/unloads them. bg3.exe creator 0x3476260 zeroes two arrays; destructor FUN_1406a2280 clears both with the trivial-array clear.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Second trivially-destructible DynamicArray (destructor FUN_1406a2280 frees +0x10). Element type not read; EntityHandle assumed by analogy with +0.

open_questions: Element type and role of the second array.
Which of the two singletons read in ProcessMemberUnloadRequests (FUN_180f59070 / FUN_180f58d60) is this component was inferred from the log texts.
status_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
second_pass: Not settled in this pass: the role and element type of the second array (+0x10) need the bg3.exe MemberUnloadSystem, which was not reached; the macOS index names InteractionRequestSystem as the only writer of the component.
